obligations.description: Delayed signed cancellation proof remains real; worker double rejects commands only after target runtime stop. Helper is not a test body or cleanup authority.
Cancel must precede HTTP listener teardown; authenticated cancelled terminal, 13 tokens, stopped announcement and no live router threads; controlled native progress, not device proof.
Cancellation after owner stream removal must still collect signed native cleanup, close pending router workers and retain stale decode-generation refusal.
Progress pump closure over two controlled transports and late prefix orderings must drain workers without pump errors.
Withheld bind/start/snapshot/stream replies retire only after authenticated cleanup; no late bind, no success on incomplete/tampered proof; chat terminal precedes owner channel release.
Even failed drain announces stopped, records rebuild_stop_timeout and retains cleanup_unproven/owner lock not released.
Registry drains gateway before route worker deadline; route close still occurs after gateway drain failure; compute/startup controlled.
Read-only discovery transport failures are observations only for a healthy current admitted worker; authority/mutation/unknown/stale/native failures stay fatal; cleanup remains reachable.

Signed cancellation retirement binds exact live claim/grant/receipt but is neither receipt ACK nor cleanup authority; bridge waits for actual native terminal; reject unsigned/forged/transplanted/stale envelopes.

Helper close_token_progress accepts cancelled keyword. No test body changed; caller compatibility/equivalence is an UNPROVEN successor obligation, not inherited python_only retirement.
Stop changes completion terminal intent without inventing generation/deadline/CAS; exact duplicate cleanup remains valid in both receipt orderings.
send_before now permits snapshot with positive <= _CLEANUP_SNAPSHOT_SLICE_SECONDS allowance and delegates send. Four test bodies unchanged; helper/body context change remains UNPROVEN.
Mailbox helper accepts cancelled keyword; eight test bodies byte-identical, surrounding helper changed. Whole-module behavior equivalence remains UNPROVEN.
